youtube_description:
Bankers Bakheda is a web series based on banking Industry....
Global Perception about banking job is still good.... But when you entered in this world of banking... As per your expectation you will get your salary but after few months you will ask so many questions to yourself. If you are a banker you know what am I talking about......
In this web series, we have tried to show bankers who enter to this banking world with good perception. In first three years they all have been able to manage hocked, abused and everything that they never ever thought of, but the best part is that after so much of abuses they all still manages to survive in the same organisation and Now they are relationship manager...They manage his/her personal and professional life very well..... They try to do business but if it's not happening Than............Bhagwan hi bhala Kare..... You know what I mean.... Well Experience bankers are aware of that, end of the day if we will not be able to achieve our target our boss will not listen any excuse and will kick on our Ass and will rape with crush words...... uffffff....... Hats off to the Bankers......... So Here we present you BANKERS BAKHEDA with lots of entertainment do watch, Like and share......And guys don't forget to subscribe.....
